scope: Additive formatting/provenance requirements from accepted 1851–1855 primary batches 14–19, after primary addendum-12; no converter or export changes.

requirements.case: Literal 125th numeric damage and attached diagrams
requirements.requirement: Preserve literal source HTML 125 with superscript th; do not silently render 125 inches or reconstruct 1/25. Hold reliable numeric rendering. Preserve both diagrams as image assets and provenance pins, with no agent prose substituted for imagery.

exact_source_evidence.quote: The wonderful little cushion, is the inner ramus metamorphosed

accepted_primary_basis.accepted_note: Raw P3 literal 125 with superscript th and no fraction markup; two diagrams viewed at extracted P10/P11.
accepted_primary_basis.ledger_requirement: retain numeric hold and image pins.

requirements.case: Translated Danish draft and scoped response
requirements.requirement: Preserve translated-from-Danish-draft status. Export neither as proven final dispatch nor as proof of Darwin receipt. Keep P1–5 comparative response scoped; P6–8 separate receipt/scientific/midden material.

exact_source_evidence.quote: On examining the two connected shell, you sent me

accepted_primary_basis.accepted_note: April 8 1852 translation from Danish draft; P1–5 answer January 3 comparison, P6–8 are separate layers.
accepted_primary_basis.accepted_decision: incoming_reverse_draft_reply; final wording, dispatch and Darwin receipt unverified.
accepted_primary_basis.ledger_requirement: preserve translated draft and scoped response.

requirements.case: Uncertain year and incomplete published extract
requirements.requirement: Keep published incomplete extract, printed/editorial date conflict, and missing note/tracings separate. Do not collapse uncertain year into exact day or treat editorial reconstruction as full authentic source.

exact_source_evidence.quote: I thank you much for your note of the 13th of May, and the tracings of the curious Bopyrid.

accepted_primary_basis.accepted_note: Printed carrier gives 1857; editors propose 1851 and possibly June 15 1851; raw XML day is not independent proof; missing note/tracings cannot be reconstructed.
accepted_primary_basis.ledger_requirement: retain date hold and unavailable portions.

requirements.requirement: Preserve enclosure as numbered list 1–77 plus two unnumbered separator rows, retaining ditto dashes, tentative punctuation, varieties and localities. Do not flatten to table or reinterpret entries as specimen count.

locators: preserved enclosure list items 1–77 plus two separators

exact_source_evidence.quote: As you formerly were very kind in sending me so many valuable fossil cirripedes, I am anxious to make some, though a very inadequate return.

accepted_primary_basis.accepted_note: Full enclosure read: 77 named species entries plus two separators; later holdings do not establish dispatch/receipt.

requirements.case: MathML mixed number, separately positioned diagram, and summary conflict
requirements.requirement: Preserve MathML 1/2 as derived 4 1/2 feet, never flat 412. Pin figure separately; its physical attachment is to closing paragraph despite DOM placement. Preserve body claim that house success is uncertain instead of editorial “found” summary.

exact_source_evidence.quote: I hope we have succeeded in a House, after infinite trouble, but am not sure

accepted_primary_basis.accepted_note: January 14 1855; raw MathML four and one-half feet, full enclosed sketch viewed; body says house uncertain contrary to summary.
accepted_primary_basis.ledger_requirement: retain MathML, image attachment, and body/summary conflict.

requirements.case: Separate letter, specimen, and book receipt/reading events
requirements.requirement: Model letter receipt, specimen arrival, book receipt, physical route, and actual reading separately. Do not infer full reading, same-day receipt, or dispatch completion from a book/specimen arriving or from editorial summary.

locators: P1 Geological Society note/report versus home arrival

accepted_primary_basis.accepted_decision: dated grounding with access/receipt distinctions; no automatic full-reading inference.

notes: Documentation only; primary notes, decisions, ledgers, source HTML/XML and figure pins remain authoritative.
No uncertain date, source wording, voice layer, list topology, figure, receipt event or summary/body conflict is silently repaired.
Root must independently verify before publishing any primary addendum.
